# API reference

<!-- Generated by tools/generate.py from spec/endpoints.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every Yativo Fiat API endpoint this SDK wraps: 124 methods in 21 resources.
Field names and response shapes are in the [Yativo API docs](https://docs.yativo.com).

- Single-object methods return the response `data` (dict or list).
- List methods return `Page` (iterate it; `.data`, `.pagination`, `.has_more`).
- Write methods (`POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`) send an `Idempotency-Key`; pass your own to make retries safe.

## Resources

- [`customers`](#customers): Your customers: the people and businesses you onboard.
- [`kyc`](#kyc): Submit and update customer KYC (individuals) and KYB (businesses).
- [`lookups`](#lookups): Reference lists used to build KYC and KYB forms.
- [`payment_methods`](#payment_methods): Discover payin (collection) and payout methods.
- [`rates`](#rates): Quotes, market rates and your fee schedule.
- [`deposits`](#deposits): Payins: collect money through local payment methods and cards.
- [`card_checkout`](#card_checkout): Card Checkout: hosted card payments for your customers' sales. Your account needs Card Checkout access.
- [`virtual_accounts`](#virtual_accounts): Virtual bank accounts for your customers.
- [`wallets`](#wallets): Your balances.
- [`beneficiaries`](#beneficiaries): Saved payout destinations.
- [`payouts`](#payouts): Send money out of your wallets.
- [`send_money`](#send_money): Quote and send transfers in one flow.
- [`swaps`](#swaps): Move balance between your own wallet currencies.
- [`transactions`](#transactions): Your transaction history.
- [`virtual_cards`](#virtual_cards): Virtual cards for your customers.
- [`crypto`](#crypto): Stablecoin deposit addresses.
- [`corporate_cards`](#corporate_cards): Corporate cards for your business customers' employees (invitation only).
- [`webhook_endpoints`](#webhook_endpoints): Register the URL that receives your webhooks. One endpoint per account.
- [`events`](#events): Webhook delivery log.
- [`ip_whitelist`](#ip_whitelist): Check your API key setup.
- [`sandbox`](#sandbox): Sandbox-only helpers.

## customers

Your customers: the people and businesses you onboard.

| Method | Endpoint | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `yativo.customers.list(**filters)` | `GET /customer` | List customers. |
| `yativo.customers.create(**fields)` | `POST /customer` | Create a customer. |
| `yativo.customers.retrieve(customer_id, **filters)` | `GET /customer/{customerId}` | Get a customer, including its endorsements. |
| `yativo.customers.update(customer_id, **fields)` | `PUT /customer/{customerId}` | Update a customer. |
| `yativo.customers.delete(customer_id)` | `DELETE /customer/{customerId}` | Delete a customer. |

## kyc

Submit and update customer KYC (individuals) and KYB (businesses).

| Method | Endpoint | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `yativo.kyc.submit_individual(**fields)` | `POST /individual-kyc/submit` | Submit individual KYC. |
| `yativo.kyc.submit_business(**fields)` | `POST /business-kyc/submit` | Submit business KYB. |
| `yativo.kyc.update_individual(customer_id, **fields)` | `PATCH /individual-kyc/{customerId}` | Partially update an individual KYC submission. |
| `yativo.kyc.update_business(customer_id, **fields)` | `PATCH /business-kyc/{customerId}` | Partially update a business KYB submission. |
| `yativo.kyc.update_submission(**fields)` | `PUT /customer/kyc/update` | Update a KYC submission. |
| `yativo.kyc.resubmit_endorsement(customer_id, endorsement, **fields)` | `POST /customer/kyc/resubmit/{customerId}/{endorsement}` | Request or resubmit an endorsement (a service such as base, sepa or card_checkout) for a customer. |

## payment_methods

Discover payin (collection) and payout methods.

| Method | Endpoint | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `yativo.payment_methods.payin(**filters)` | `GET /payment-methods/payin` | List payin methods. Pass country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3) and currency. Each method's id is the gateway for deposits.create. |
| `yativo.payment_methods.payin_countries(**filters)` | `GET /payment-methods/payin/countries` | List countries you can collect payments in. |
| `yativo.payment_methods.payin_currencies(**filters)` | `GET /payment-methods/payin/currency` | List payin currencies for a country. Pass country (alpha-3). |
| `yativo.payment_methods.payout(**filters)` | `GET /payment-methods/payout` | List payout methods. |
| `yativo.payment_methods.payout_countries(**filters)` | `GET /payment-methods/payout/countries` | List countries you can pay out to. |
| `yativo.payment_methods.payout_form(payment_method_id, **filters)` | `GET /beneficiary/form/show/{paymentMethodId}` | Get the fields a payout method needs for a beneficiary. |

## rates

Quotes, market rates and your fee schedule.

| Method | Endpoint | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `yativo.rates.quote(**fields)` | `POST /exchange-rate` | Create a quote. With method_id and method_type it locks the rate for 5 minutes and returns a quote_id. |
| `yativo.rates.market(**filters)` | `GET /exchange-rates` | Live indicative market rates for display. |
| `yativo.rates.fees(**filters)` | `GET /fees` | Your fees for every payin and payout method. |

## deposits

Payins: collect money through local payment methods and cards.

| Method | Endpoint | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `yativo.deposits.create(**fields)` | `POST /wallet/deposits/new` | Create a deposit. Returns deposit_url, the hosted page to send your payer to. |
| `yativo.deposits.list(**filters)` | `GET /wallet/deposits` | List deposits. Filter by gateway, currency, customer_id, start_date and end_date. |
| `yativo.deposits.retrieve(deposit_id)` | `GET /wallet/deposits/{depositId}` | Get one deposit by its id or deposit_id. Use it to confirm status before you fulfil an order. |

## card_checkout

Card Checkout: hosted card payments for your customers' sales. Your account needs Card Checkout access.

| Method | Endpoint | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `yativo.card_checkout.account()` | `GET /card-checkout/account` | Your Card Checkout access, pricing and balance. |
| `yativo.card_checkout.request_access(**fields)` | `POST /card-checkout/account/request-access` | Request Card Checkout access. Optional note. |
| `yativo.card_checkout.customer(customer_id)` | `GET /card-checkout/customers/{customerId}` | A customer's card_checkout endorsement. |
| `yativo.card_checkout.submit_endorsement(customer_id, **fields)` | `POST /card-checkout/customers/{customerId}/endorsement` | Submit a customer's card_checkout endorsement. Returns an onboarding_url. |
| `yativo.card_checkout.onboarding_link(customer_id, **fields)` | `POST /card-checkout/customers/{customerId}/onboarding` | Create a fresh onboarding link. Optional return_url and refresh_url. |
| `yativo.card_checkout.verification(customer_id)` | `GET /card-checkout/customers/{customerId}/verification` | Get the verification form, prefilled from the customer's KYB. |
| `yativo.card_checkout.submit_verification(customer_id, **fields)` | `POST /card-checkout/customers/{customerId}/verification` | Submit business verification details. |
| `yativo.card_checkout.create_order(**fields)` | `POST /card-checkout/orders` | Create a checkout order. Send the buyer to the returned checkout_url. |
| `yativo.card_checkout.list_orders(**filters)` | `GET /card-checkout/orders` | List orders. Filter by status, customer_id and reference. |
| `yativo.card_checkout.retrieve_order(order_id)` | `GET /card-checkout/orders/{orderId}` | Get an order. Act on its status, not on the buyer's redirect. |

## virtual_cards

Virtual cards for your customers.

| Method | Endpoint | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `yativo.virtual_cards.activate_customer(**fields)` | `POST /customer/virtual/cards/activate` | Enable a customer for virtual cards. |
| `yativo.virtual_cards.create(**fields)` | `POST /customer/virtual/cards/create` | Create a card. |

## webhook_endpoints

Register the URL that receives your webhooks. One endpoint per account.

| Method | Endpoint | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `yativo.webhook_endpoints.list(**filters)` | `GET /business/webhook` | Your webhook endpoint. |
| `yativo.webhook_endpoints.create(**fields)` | `POST /business/webhook` | Create or replace your endpoint (url). Returns a new secret: store it. |
| `yativo.webhook_endpoints.update(webhook_id, **fields)` | `PUT /business/webhook/{webhookId}` | Change the URL. The secret stays the same. |
| `yativo.webhook_endpoints.delete(webhook_id)` | `DELETE /business/webhook/{webhookId}` | Delete your endpoint. |
| `yativo.webhook_endpoints.regenerate_secret(webhook_id, **fields)` | `POST /business/webhook/{webhookId}/regenerate-secret` | Issue a new secret. The old one stops working at once. |

## events

| Method | Endpoint | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `yativo.events.list(**filters)` | `GET /business/events/all` | List delivery attempts. |
| `yativo.events.retrieve(event_id)` | `GET /business/events/show/{eventId}` | Get one delivery attempt. |
| `yativo.events.resend(event_id, **fields)` | `POST /business/events/resend/{eventId}` | Resend an event to your current URL, signed with your current secret. |
